perturbation: add positive dose to the angle of every ar>=2.1 prediction; preserve identity, score, class, center, width and height
evaluator: full evaluator with rematching at IoU 0.50 and 0.75
empirical_tolerance: smallest 0.5-degree away-from-GT rotation at which fixed matched-pair IoU crosses tau; approximation to evaluator state change
missing_complete_prediction_policy: report unavailable; never substitute matched-only AP or superseded partial-GT AP
